equation: Tm = T0 + sum_(i<j) xi*xj*[b0 + b1*E_strain,ij + b2*E_chem,ij]
notes: The global prediction uses three fixed coefficients, elemental properties and simple-oxide reference states.
O(-II) is a formal-valence convention, not a measured local atomic charge.
The Hf-family estimate scales signed binary chemical-system OOF residuals by nominal vacancy-fraction ratios.
The six literature family targets have the same vacancy fractions as their supports and do not validate concentration scaling.
A family estimate is not an isolated thermodynamic vacancy contribution or guaranteed improvement over the global prediction.

hf_local_transfer.scope: nominal-vacancy-scaled binary OOF residual transfer for two-/three-cation Hf-family targets
hf_local_transfer.binary_output_semantics: vacancy-scaled family estimate; not independent external validation
hf_local_transfer.support_selection: nearest nominal vacancy fraction among same-dopant same-valence eligible supports
hf_local_transfer.local_subset_validation_scope: six same-vacancy-fraction targets; same-study composition transfer
